## Rule

Two nonzero colors appear in the active top-left grid. Treat the nonzero color with the largest bounding-box area as the frame/container and the other nonzero color as the inner marker. Compare the inner marker bbox center to the frame bbox center; draw diagonal ray(s) of the inner color outward from the opposite frame corner(s), clipped to the valid input grid. Preserve the original nonzero cells and background.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
fg_masks = one_hot_nonzero_colors(input[:12, :12])
valid = any_channel_present(input[:12, :12])
bboxes = per_color_bbox(fg_masks)
frame = argmax_bbox_area(bboxes)
inner = present_color & ~frame

row_side = top if inner_center_row >= frame_center_row else bottom
col_side = left/right/both from inner_center_col vs frame_center_col
ray = diagonal_from_selected_frame_corners(row_side, col_side) & valid
canvas = color_index(input[:12, :12])
canvas[ray] = inner_color
canvas[~valid] = 10
output = one_hot(pad(canvas, fill=10), colors=0..9)
```

## Cost analysis

2026-06-01 parent breakdown (`score_network_v2`: memory 63,934 + params 73 = cost 64,007): the dominant single tensor is only `[1,10,12,12]` F32 = 5,760 B, but there are nine of them (`input_inner`, `nz_ch`, four row/col sentinel planes, `ray_fg`, `bg`, `output_inner`) for 51,840 B total. The casts that looked suspicious are small by comparison: four ray casts plus `ray_mask` are `[1,1,12,12]` F32 = 576 B each, and `inner_vec` is only 40 B.

Winning v1 cost is memory 3,091 + params 85 = 3,176. Remaining cost is mostly: padded UINT8 canvas = 900 B, color F32 canvas = 576 B, and the two candidate-mask planes (`fg_bool`/`fg_u8`) = 576 B. The key reductions were: single-channel color canvas, color0-as-10 canvas coding with output IDs `[10,1..9]`, reducing the foreground universe from 9 colors to the two discovered nonzero colors, discovering colors from the tiny channel-presence vector instead of a full color plane, UINT8 bbox occupancy with ArgMax, height-only frame selection after corpus validation, F16 scalar geometry, removing present/tie safety plumbing after corpus checks, collapsing four diagonal rays into one selected-distance equality, square-grid row/column validity clipping, opset 12 ReduceSum axes attributes, and final BOOL output.

## Don't-do log

- Do not chase the old crop advisory as a standalone polish: the canonical graph already works on a 12x12 crop and pads only at the output.
- Do not use dense 19x19 crop-collapse weights; the dilated 2x2 Conv with dilation 18 gives the same 12x12 top-left read with 40 params instead of 3,610.
- Do not rebuild rmax/cmax with reverse Gather; `ArgMax(select_last_index=1)` on row/col occupancy is cheaper and byte-equal.
- Do not carry all 9 foreground color channels for this generator family; discover min/max nonzero colors and operate on two candidate masks instead.
- Do not retry whole-graph f16 conversion; prior worker found it either larger, type-broken, or ORT-invalid.
- Do not use sparse initializers for the crop-collapse Conv under the official score path: ORT can run a sanitizer-name-stable sparse Conv and gates can pass, but `onnx.checker.check_model(..., full_check=True)` / shape inference rejects sparse Conv weights, so `score_network_v2` returns `None`.
- Do not reduce/argmax BOOL masks directly; ORT rejects BOOL inputs for `ReduceMax` and `ArgMax`.
- Do not chase UINT8 scalar arithmetic for bbox geometry; ORT accepts UINT8 `Min`/`Max`/comparisons, but rejects UINT8 `Add`/`Sub`/`Mul`, so F16 remains the compact working arithmetic type.
- Do not reintroduce the 12x12 `Mod(color,10)` base-color plane; final output IDs `[10,1..9]` make inside background code 10 decode to channel 0 while padded/outside code 0 decodes to all-zero.
- (factorized family) Do not try to remove/shrink `embed12x30` (360 params): it is an `[I12|0]` identity that keeps every working tensor 12-wide so the only 30×30 tensor is the FREE graph `output`. Rendering at 12×12 then `Pad` exposes a 2880 B intermediate (net +2528). It is the cheapest padding, not waste.
- (factorized family) Do not keep the MaxPool index chain 4D past the Cast to save the extra 40 B: making `channel_row_offsets`/downstream `first_row` 4D makes the scoring `Sub(row_moment [1,10], top_penalty [1,10,1,1])` broadcast to `[1,10,1,10]`. The 2D↔4D collision in the moment scoring blocks it; cast-then-squeeze back to `[1,10]` (the shipped 2614 shave) is the clean −40.
- (factorized family) Do not F16 the per-channel scoring plumbing (`row_moment`/`col_moment`/`masked_score`/`neg_score`): `neg_score=-100000` overflows F16 (max 65504) and `score_scale=4096` risks flipping the structural-color ArgMax tie-break. Keep F32.
